messages:
alex_cs: Quick Day0 sync for PaperTrail private VPC onboarding. They report no audit logs reaching their SIEM and the forwarder shows KMS decrypt errors + connection refused to the SIEM. Need help triaging. cc @sam_ops @linda_security @priya_se

sam_ops: On it. Can you paste the agent output exactly and confirm which port/proto the SIEM expects? Also do they use a proxy for egress? :mag:

alex_cs: Agent lines: "ERROR: kms DecryptDenied" and "ERROR: connect to siem.papertrail.internal:443: connection refused". They say the forwarder is configured for HTTPS on 443. Provided KMS ARN arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:888888888:key/ef01-2345 and forwarder role arn:aws:iam::888888888:role/papertrail-forwarder.

linda_security: KMS checklist: cross-account decryption needs a key policy entry explicitly allowing the forwarder role and our service principal (arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/redwood-inference-prod) to kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. Recommend they avoid wildcard principals. I'll draft a minimal policy snippet for them.

priya_se: Runbook update: added KMS policy example + short section on egress (HTTPS via 443 vs raw syslog/TCP 514). For HTTPS we require outbound 443 from their private subnet (NAT or proxy) and SNI-friendly routing; for TCP-based syslog they need to allow that port to the SIEM endpoints.

jon_eng: Quick diagnostic they can run from a host in the VPC: ```curl -v --connect-timeout 5 https://siem.papertrail.internal:443 || openssl s_client -connect siem.papertrail.internal:443 -servername siem.papertrail.internal``` If that fails it's an egress/NAT/EACL issue. If they permit, I can run a probe from our temporary test instance (need either SSH access or they open probe CIDR 52.40.16.0/28).

alex_cs: They ran curl and saw TLS handshake timeout. They confirmed a NAT gateway but said their outbound ACLs are deliberately narrow and probably block the SIEM IPs. They're willing to add rules if we provide necessary IPs.

linda_security: Don't ask them to open wide ranges. Suggest they either allow destination by FQDN (SNI) or whitelist the SIEM vendor's published egress IPs. I'll request the vendor IP list; in parallel push the KMS policy change which is lower friction.

sam_ops: Action items: 1) PaperTrail infra to add KMS key policy entry to allow forwarder role + redwood service principal (owner: linda_security to draft and send). 2) PaperTrail infra to open outbound 443 to SIEM IPs or allow via proxy (owner: their infra, coordinated by sam_ops). 3) Jon to run probe during agreed window once CIDR is allowed. 4) Contingency: buffered S3 sink we can ingest (owner: priya_se) if direct forwarding delayed. Who will notify the AE and update renewal risk? @maria_ae

maria_ae: Notified. Renewal review in 13 days and customer flagged this as a production blocker. If logs aren't demonstrably flowing before the renewal discussion they may escalate and pause. I'll schedule a stakeholders check-in tomorrow to show mitigation steps. We need a demonstrable mitigation (S3 buffer or direct flow) by EoW to reduce churn risk.

priya_se: Proposed temporary mitigation: configure forwarder to write to customer-owned S3 (cross-account PutObject) as a buffer; we can pull from that S3 into our pipeline for a short period. Requires them to add a bucket policy allowing the forwarder role to PutObject and optionally add our read-role. This is fast and buys time.

alex_cs: Customer prefers end-to-end to SIEM but accepts S3 buffer as short-term. They've approved opening our probe CIDR for 2 hours. I'll ask for the KMS policy change now and the S3 bucket details if they want the fallback.

deploy-bot: Probe window scheduled: 2026-04-04T14:00:00Z 14:30Z (owner: jon_eng)

jon_eng: I'll run connectivity checks and paste tcpdump/openssl output in this thread. If we still see handshake timeouts after egress is opened, we'll focus on TLS fingerprinting/SNI mismatch.

linda_security: Draft policy snippet I'll send to their security contact (recommend explicit role ARN): ```{
  "Sid": "AllowForwarderDecrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::888888888:role/papertrail-forwarder" },
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}``` Also mention rotation/trust implications if they want Redwood-managed CMK rotation.

maria_ae: I'll run the stakeholder touchpoint and ask our exec sponsor to join if needed. If we can show S3 receiving logs by EoW I'll mark renewal risk as mitigated for the call.

alex_cs: Summary (owners): - KMS key policy change (linda_security) - Egress allowlist or proxy config (papertrail infra, coordinated by sam_ops) - Probe run 2026-04-04 14:00Z (jon_eng) - Temporary S3 buffer (priya_se) - AE stakeholder update (maria_ae).

Please speak up if you want to swap any ownership or if I missed something. :white_check_mark:
